review.use_summary: Aligned Saccharomyces MGE1 homolog protein sequences with 7.505 using local pairwise alignment and a 1,000-iteration maximum; Jalview then calculated conservation and displayed the alignment.
review.implementation_scope_note: The exact 7.505 profile supports declared protein LOCAL_PAIR with maximum_iterations=1000. Reciprocal BLAST searches, manual ORF curation and Jalview conservation/visualization are separate operations. Synthetic source/integrity controls do not reproduce the paper sequences or biological conclusions.

review.use_summary: Aligned concatenated nucleotide sequences of 142 core genes from 34 Bifidobacterium MAGs and 14 reference genomes with 7.313 before microseq trimming and IQ-TREE phylogenetic classification.
review.implementation_scope_note: The exact 7.313 nucleotide profile is available, but the paragraph does not specify its alignment strategy or full command. Roary/core-gene construction, microseq trimming and IQ-TREE inference are separate. Require explicit user choices rather than inferring the missing algorithm; the paper data have not been reproduced.

review.use_summary: Used the MAFFT add tool to align structure-mined membrane-binding domain proteins to residues visible in the R. norvegicus PHPLCδ X-ray reference 1MAI; reported auto strategy, BLOSUM62, gap opening 1.53 and offset 0.0.
review.implementation_scope_note: WARNING: the paper reports only major version 7. Its exact edition remains unresolved and paper-exact execution must be skipped; no tested edition is silently substituted. The generic exact-edition adapter supports a single-row protein backbone and these explicit scoring settings. Reference-residue extraction, predicted structures and PyMOL structural alignment/RMSD are separate, and keep-length behavior is not specified in the paragraph.

review.use_summary: Used 7.490 to align NxrA/NarG and AmoA protein sequences before trimAl filtering and IQ-TREE trees. The additional phylogenomic paragraph also uses 7.490 for Nitrobacter-like cytoplasmic NxrA sequences and defined outgroups.
review.implementation_scope_note: The exact 7.490 protein profile is available. Neither cited paragraph specifies the complete MAFFT strategy/scoring command, so those choices remain explicit. Protein selection, trimAl thresholds, model selection, bootstrap inference, rerooting and visualization are downstream or separate contracts; the paper phylogenies have not been reconstructed.

supporting_evidence.section: Methods / Phylogenomic investigation of nitrifier genera, and Nitrobacter-like NxrA containing MAGs compared to NxrA gene phylogeny

review.use_summary: Generated gene-level multiple sequence alignments with 7.475 for in-house Perl estimates of pangenome diversity π, using differential-site count, conserved alignment length and the number of sequence pairs.
review.implementation_scope_note: WARNING: retain the maintainer FFT-NS-i/auto memory-bug warning for exact 7.475. The paragraph specifies neither the MAFFT input alphabet nor strategy; do not infer either from surrounding genome/protein steps. The adapter requires both explicitly. The conserved-site definition, custom Perl diversity calculation and whole gene-batch workflow remain separate; successful synthetic alignments do not establish large-input behavior.

review.use_summary: Aligned MT-A70 family proteins in 7.475 L-INS-i mode before trimAl and IQ-TREE analysis. A separate selection-analysis paragraph reused MAFFT protein alignments with matching nucleotide sequences in PAL2NAL to create codon alignments for EasyCodeML.
review.implementation_scope_note: The exact 7.475 protein/local-pair profile supports an explicit refinement maximum; the paper names L-INS-i but does not provide every effective command option. Preserve the original-release FFT-NS-i/auto memory-bug warning without silently upgrading. HMM/BLAST discovery, trimming, phylogeny, PAL2NAL back-translation and CodeML selection testing are separate; the adapter does not claim to reproduce them.

review.use_summary: Aligned longest-transcript protein sequences from single-copy gene families across 13 wheat subspecies and barley Morex v.3 with 7.526 before IQ-TREE2 gene-tree construction and ASTRAL analysis.
review.implementation_scope_note: The exact 7.526 protein profile is available, but the paragraph does not state the MAFFT strategy or complete command. Its -AUTO flag belongs to IQ-TREE2 and is not inferred as a MAFFT setting. Single-copy family/longest-transcript selection, per-gene batching, IQ-TREE and ASTRAL remain separate contracts; no paper tree has been reconstructed.

review.use_summary: Aligned recombination-aware intronic/intergenic genomic sequences with 7.487 global pairwise alignment and a reported 100-iteration setting, followed by Jalview inspection, manual removal of misaligned segments and phylogenetic inference.
review.implementation_scope_note: The exact 7.487 nucleotide GLOBAL_PAIR profile exposes maximum_iterations=100; this does not assert that 100 iterations actually ran. Genome alignment, coordinate/sequence extraction, LD-aware region selection, Jalview/manual curation, IQ-TREE inference and dating remain separate operations. The uncurated synthetic alignment controls do not reproduce the manually edited paper alignment.
